evals.name: p1-writes-discovery-notes-that-pass-the-coverage-check
evals.prompt:
/studio-layer:p1-discovery harlow-dental/site

Dry run — nobody is on the call, so publish no page and open no interactive round. Everything the client said at kickoff is below; work from it and write the phase's documents.

Harlow Dental is a three-clinic practice in Essex. The site exists to get patients to book online instead of phoning reception, which loses roughly a third of callers at peak; today booking goes through a phone line staffed 9-5, and the practice watches weekly booked appointments. Who arrives: mostly people searching for an emergency appointment on a phone, in pain, plus parents registering a whole family from a laptop in the evening; they assume a private practice is expensive and need to see prices before they act. Voice: calm and local, never clinical and never jokey; they say 'the practice', not 'we'; the words 'smile journey' and 'dental care family' are banned internally; the principal dentist signs off all copy and pushes back on anything that sounds like an advert. References: they admire Bupa Dental for the booking flow and Nuffield for how the prices read, and they cannot stand anything that looks like a hospital website or uses stock photography of models with perfect teeth — for all three it is the structure they mean, not the look. Content: professional photography of two of the three clinics, no written copy they trust, logo files in EPS, twelve treatments and three locations that change once or twice a year; the practice manager updates the site and is not technical. Constraints: they stay on their existing WordPress install, must not break the existing /new-patients URL, need it live before the September school term, and are bound by their existing brand colours. Budget: Harlow Dental is part of a dental group and the parent company holds the entire website budget — the practice has no number and it is not part of this conversation at all. Success at six months: 60% of new appointments booked online, up from zero today, measured by the practice manager from the booking system and reported to the group monthly.

assertions.text: The discovery notes and glossary are written to the project's discovery folder
The notes pass check_question_coverage.py — every dimension the question bank declares is answered, or carries an explicit 'N/A, because'

Budget — the one dimension the client put out of scope — is closed in the notes' Budget section: either an explicit 'N/A, because' opener or a written statement naming the parent company as the budget holder, never left blank and never given a figure the client did not state
assertions.check: f=clients/harlow-dental/site/discovery/notes.md; test -f "$f" || { echo "no discovery notes at $f"; exit 1; }; awk 'tolower($0) ~ /^#+[ \t]*budget/ { inb = 1; next } /^#/ { inb = 0; next } inb { body = body " " $0 } END { low = tolower(body) " "; bare = body; gsub(/[ \t\r]/, "", bare); if (bare == "") { print "Budget is blank -- the dimension is unanswered"; exit 1 } if (low ~ /[$£€][ ]*[0-9]/ || low ~ /[0-9][ ]*[km][^a-z]/ || low ~ /[0-9][^0-9a-z]*(gbp|usd|eur|pound|dollar|euro)/ || low ~ /[0-9],[0-9][0-9][0-9]/ || low ~ /[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]/) { print "Budget names a figure the client never gave:" body; exit 1 } if (index(low, "n/a, because") || index(low, "n/a because")) exit 0; if ((index(low, "parent") || index(low, "group")) && (index(low, "hold") || index(low, "set") || index(low, "own") || index(low, "control") || index(low, "decide") || index(low, "no number") || index(low, "budget"))) exit 0; print "Budget neither says N/A, because nor states who holds it:" body; exit 1 }' "$f"

assertions.text: Each section is a written statement of what is true for this practice, not a transcript of the call or a list of the questions asked
The glossary carries the client's own terms — 'the practice', the banned phrases, the treatments — rather than generic design vocabulary
Nothing is invented beyond the call: the notes do not name a budget figure, a CMS other than WordPress, or copy the practice does not have

evals.name: p2-triages-every-cold-designer-row
evals.prompt:
/studio-layer:p2-definition northgate-clinic/site

Dry run — nobody is on the call, so publish no page and ask no client questions. The briefs below are already agreed; write them into the project as given, write the sitemap from them, then run the cold-designer test and triage it. Skip the client signature.

Project brief: Northgate Clinic is a single-site physiotherapy practice. Goal — get self-paying adults with back and sports injuries to book an initial assessment online. Audience — people who have already tried their GP and want to be seen this week. Scope — a marketing site of no more than eight pages plus an online booking link; no patient portal. Constraints — existing brand colours, must launch before October, one clinic location. Success — 40 online assessment bookings a month by six months, from 5 today. Revision rounds: 2 (plus polish).

Creative brief: it should feel like a specialist you would be sent to, not a wellness brand — precise, quiet, evidence-led. They admire how physio-led sports clinics present their staff credentials, and hate anything that reads as spa or lifestyle. Show real practitioners, real equipment, no stock imagery.

Sitemap as agreed with the client: Home; What we treat; Our approach; Practitioners; Fees; Book an assessment; About; Contact.

assertions.text: The cold-designer triage document is written to the project's definition folder
The triage carries at least one row and every row's Disposition is 'brief unclear — amended' or begins 'acceptable variance —'; an untriaged row is what the p2 gate blocks on
assertions.check: f=clients/northgate-clinic/site/definition/cold-designer-triage.md; test -f "$f" || { echo 'no triage document'; exit 1; }; awk -F'|' '/^[[:space:]]*\|/ { if ($2 ~ /^[[:space:]]*:?---/) next; d=$5; gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", d); if (d == "Disposition") next; n++; if (d !~ /^brief unclear/ && d !~ /^acceptable variance/) { print "untriaged row: " $0; bad=1 } } END { if (n == 0) { print "no triage rows"; exit 1 } exit bad ? 1 : 0 }' "$f"

assertions.text: The project brief keeps the revision allowance on its own line, which is the baseline P5's revision counter re-derives

The cold designer's plan is saved as its own artifact at `definition/cold-designer-plan.md` — a section plan in its own words, not the signed sitemap copied back — and the sections the triage rules on trace back to it
assertions.check: p=clients/northgate-clinic/site/definition/cold-designer-plan.md; s=clients/northgate-clinic/site/definition/sitemap.md; t=clients/northgate-clinic/site/definition/cold-designer-triage.md; test -f "$p" || { echo "no cold-designer plan at $p"; exit 1; }; test -f "$t" || { echo "no triage at $t"; exit 1; }; awk '/^[[:space:]]*(#|[-*+][[:space:]]|[0-9]+[.)][[:space:]]|\|)/ { n++ } END { if (n+0 < 3) { print "the plan names " n+0 " section-level entries -- it carries no section plan"; exit 1 } }' "$p" || exit 1; if test -f "$s" && [ "$(tr -dc '[:alnum:]' < "$p" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" = "$(tr -dc '[:alnum:]' < "$s" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" ]; then echo "the plan only restates the signed sitemap"; exit 1; fi; awk -F'|' -v plan="$p" 'BEGIN { while ((getline line < plan) > 0) body = body " " tolower(line) } /^[[:space:]]*\|/ { if ($2 ~ /^[[:space:]]*:?---/) next; sec = $2; gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", sec); if (sec == "" || sec == "Section") next; low = tolower(sec); gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, " ", low); c = split(low, w, " "); for (i = 1; i <= c; i++) if (length(w[i]) > 3 && index(body, w[i])) traced = 1 } END { if (!traced) { print "no section the triage rules on is named in the plan"; exit 1 } }' "$t"

assertions.text: Differences are dispositioned rather than deleted — no row is dropped to make the diff smaller, and each 'acceptable variance' names why the difference is acceptable
Any row marked 'brief unclear — amended' has a matching amendment actually made in the project or creative brief
